setup2fa.title: Secure your account with 2FA
setup2fa.lead: Management and project-manager accounts need two-factor authentication before they can access the dashboard. It takes about 60 seconds — once and you’re done.
setup2fa.step1Body: Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, or Microsoft Authenticator all work. Install one now if you don’t already have it.
setup2fa.step2Body: In the app, tap “Add new account” and scan the QR code below. The app will save a new Priya’s profile.
setup2fa.step3Body: The app shows a 6-digit code that refreshes every 30 seconds. Enter it below to confirm setup.
setup2fa.helpLine: Stuck? Email us at <mail>support@priyas-cleaning.de</mail> — we respond within 15 minutes.
